info.name: VMware vSphere Automation REST Clusters Datastores API

params.name: filter.datastores
params.description: Identifiers of datastores to filter by

params.name: filter.names
params.description: Names of datastores to filter by

params.name: filter.types
params.description: Types of datastores to filter by

params.name: filter.folders
params.description: Folders that must contain the datastores

params.name: filter.datacenters
params.description: Datacenters that must contain the datastores

items.docs: Returns a list of datastores in the vCenter inventory matching the specified filter criteria. Results can be filtered by name, type, datacenter, and folder.
Returns detailed information about the specified datastore including capacity, free space, type, and accessible hosts.
